why_these_block_the_shadow_census: The 238-row shadow recensus stays staged until both are settled. A promotion would otherwise have to guess: it would either admit ten municipalities nobody ruled on, or evict 24 candidates that fall inside this market's own committed bounds. Guessing either way writes a boundary decision into a census under a work order that never made one.

A_boundary.question: Ten municipalities, all of them inside the market's committed geographic_bounds, none registered on any corridor's included_cities and none in the discovery included_municipalities. They are not a boundary the market drew -- they are the residue of which city strings happened to be typed into a corridor list. Under MARKET_GEOGRAPHY a candidate in one of them is BORDERLINE and is HELD, which is why 24 real candidates sit unresolved rather than being dropped.

B_3764_s_state_st.question: Two committed identities normalise to one street identity, 3764|state|48108. Are they two hotels at one doorway, or one building whose Motel 6 identity is stale? The committed collision audit never flagged the pair because it compares raw street_identity strings ('3764 s state st' vs '3764 south state street') while address_key normalises both to one key.

identities.identity_key: residence inn by marriott ann arbor south
identities.canonical_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Ann Arbor South

evidence_carried_forward: Motel 6's OWN Ann Arbor locator -- the exact URL the committed row carries as its official_url -- reads '6 motels in Ann Arbor MI' and lists six properties, every one of them in a DIFFERENT city (Farmington Hills, Southgate, Warren, Toledo, Rossford, Southgate). No Motel 6 in Ann Arbor at all, and none at 3764 S State St. Read in an attended browser at zero cost on 2026-08-29.

The Residence Inn's own property page exists and carries Marriott property code dtwrp, a phone, and name+address+phone corroboration. It could NOT be read: the page is behind an Akamai wall and served no content. Recorded as an ACCESS OUTCOME, never as evidence about the property -- a wall proves nothing about what is behind it.
The Motel 6 row is the weaker record of the two by every available measure: a CITY-level brand URL with no property code, bound PAGE_RENDERED, and no phone.
B_3764_s_state_st.confidence: MODERATE -- one first-party source, corroborated by the weakness of the Motel 6 record itself, and NOT by a reading of the Residence Inn page, which could not be read.
what_would_settle_it_at_zero_cost: An attended read of the Residence Inn dtwrp page from a session that gets past the Akamai wall -- the Detroit market has broken that wall before with an attended browser -- comparing its STATED street address against 3764 S State St.
A recorded operator telephone call to (734) 590-7500, asking what previously operated at that address.
Neither costs anything. Neither has been done, so the pair stays unruled.
B_3764_s_state_st.guard_status: The same-doorway guard holds this pair APART by default: each names a different official page, so neither can absorb the other in any recensus. The question cannot resolve itself while it waits.
